Subject: Kickoff: New Leads 30-day coaching sprint + Sensitive Escalation Playbook

Team —

Running a quick pilot for new managers (cohort A) to accelerate their first 30 days on performance management and handling sensitive conversations. Goal: reduce time-to-quality for new leads and ensure consistent escalation hygiene when things get sticky.

Proposed kickoff: Wed 8/12, 10:00–11:30 PT (review agenda + live clinic). Two mandatory components for cohort A:
- Performance calibration workshop (calibrating ratings, evidence-based feedback)
- Difficult-conversations clinic (role-play + templated language + escalation routing)

Attachments: performance-review-cheatsheet.pdf; sensitive-convo-templates.docx

Please confirm availability and any must-have agenda items by EOD Tue. I need People Ops + Legal sign-off on the escalation flow before we run the clinic.

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad | Director, People & Manager Development
Redwood Inference
[attachment: performance-review-cheatsheet.pdf] [attachment: sensitive-convo-templates.docx]

2) Legal/HR should sign off on the escalation playbook and the manager confidentiality acknowledgement. Adding Sarah Liu from our HR partner for a quick review.

Hi team —

Happy to review. A couple of resources attached, plus a one-page manager confidentiality acknowledgement we typically use for sensitive escalation clinics. I can send a DocuSign packet if you want everyone to acknowledge prior to the clinic.

Attachments: manager-confidentiality-ack.pdf; escalation-flow-template.xlsx
DocuSign acknowledgement link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/confirm/XYZ-acknowledgement

I recommend:
- Managers complete the confidentiality ack 48 hours before the clinic
- People Ops host calibration data (anonymized) and provide a short brief for the workshop

If you want, I can join the clinic for the legal/HR section on escalation handling.

Best,
Sarah Liu

All — good plan. My asks before kickoff:
- Headcount for cohort A (how many managers will attend live vs. async)
- Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can track completion and enable CS/AM teams to push people through if needed. I've attached a simple MAP template (MAP-q3-managers.xlsx).

If the 8/12 time conflicts for a few folks, can we run a recording + shorter follow-up clinic? Otherwise I can free up the 10:00 slot.

Thanks team — quick status and updated agenda below.

Status:
- Cohort A = 14 managers confirmed live, 6 recorded/async (asked leads to prioritize live attendance).
- Rohan will ingest anonymized calibration data by Tue EOD and circulate the short brief.
- Sarah will send the DocuSign acknowledgement; we'll require completion 48h before clinic.

Final agenda (8/12, 10:00–11:30 PT):
1) 10:00–10:20 — Calibration framing + data brief (Rohan)
2) 10:20–11:00 — Role-play clinic (breakout pairs; observed by cohort leads)
3) 11:00–11:20 — Escalation flow & confidentiality obligations (Sarah)
4) 11:20–11:30 — Go-forward actions (MAP owner, completion deadlines)

I've uploaded the materials to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bManagerOnboardingMaterials
Please review the sensitive templates and the MAP before Wed.

Action items assigned:
- Rohan: anonymize and share calibration brief by Tue EOD
- Sarah: send DocuSign ack and escalation checklist by EOD Tue
- Laura & Marissa: finalize MAP owners and participant list

If anyone has a hard conflict, let me know and we'll record the session and run a shorter follow-up clinic.

Mina
Director, People & Manager Development
Redwood Inference
